<script>
(function () {
  var el = document.querySelector('.home-typed');
  if (el && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    var roles = el.dataset.roles.split('|'), r = 0, i = roles[0].length, del = false;
    (function tick() {
      var word = roles[r];
      el.textContent = word.slice(0, i);
      var wait = del ? 45 : 85;
      if (!del && i === word.length) { del = true; wait = 1800; }
      else if (del && i === 0) { del = false; r = (r + 1) % roles.length; wait = 350; }
      else { i += del ? -1 : 1; }
      setTimeout(tick, wait);
    })();
  }
  var nums = document.querySelectorAll('.home-num');
  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (e) {
      if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
      io.unobserve(e.target);
      var n = +e.target.dataset.count, k = 0;
      var t = setInterval(function () { k++; e.target.textContent = k; if (k >= n) clearInterval(t); }, 900 / n);
    });
  }, { threshold: .5 });
  nums.forEach(function (n) { n.textContent = '0'; io.observe(n); });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var still = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* Moving graph network behind the hero */
  var cv = document.querySelector('.home-net');
  if (cv && !still) {
    var ctx = cv.getContext('2d'), W, H, dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2), pts = [], mouse = {x: -999, y: -999};
    function size() {
      W = cv.clientWidth; H = cv.clientHeight;
      cv.width = W * dpr; cv.height = H * dpr; ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      var n = Math.round(Math.min(90, W * H / 14000));
      pts = [];
      for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) pts.push({x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, vx: (Math.random() - .5) * .45, vy: (Math.random() - .5) * .45, r: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.2});
    }
    size(); window.addEventListener('resize', size);
    cv.parentElement.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { var b = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); mouse.x = e.clientX - b.left; mouse.y = e.clientY - b.top; });
    cv.parentElement.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { mouse.x = mouse.y = -999; });
    (function draw() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      for (var a = 0; a < pts.length; a++) {
        var p = pts[a];
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
        if (p.x < 0 || p.x > W) p.vx *= -1;
        if (p.y < 0 || p.y > H) p.vy *= -1;
        for (var b = a + 1; b < pts.length; b++) {
          var q = pts[b], dx = p.x - q.x, dy = p.y - q.y, d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
          if (d < 16000) { ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(143,180,230,' + (0.28 * (1 - d / 16000)) + ')'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y); ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y); ctx.stroke(); }
        }
        var mx = p.x - mouse.x, my = p.y - mouse.y, md = mx * mx + my * my;
        if (md < 30000) { ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(190,215,245,' + (0.45 * (1 - md / 30000)) + ')'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y); ctx.stroke(); }
        ctx.fillStyle = a % 7 === 0 ? 'rgba(240,160,100,.9)' : 'rgba(169,198,232,.75)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    })();
  }

  /* Live-typing code panel behind the photo */
  var code = document.querySelector('.home-code-body');
  if (code) {
    var src = [
      'import torch',
      'from torch_geometric.nn import GATConv',
      '',
      'class ScreeningForecaster(torch.nn.Module):',
      '    """Spatio-temporal GNN for uptake"""',
      '    def __init__(self, f_in, hidden=64):',
      '        super().__init__()',
      '        self.gat = GATConv(f_in, hidden, heads=4)',
      '        self.gru = torch.nn.GRU(hidden*4, hidden)',
      '        self.head = torch.nn.Linear(hidden, 1)',
      '',
      '    def forward(self, x, edge_index):',
      '        h = self.gat(x, edge_index).relu()',
      '        h, _ = self.gru(h)',
      '        return self.head(h)',
      '',
      '# fairness check across deprivation groups',
      'for group in wimd_quintiles:',
      '    gap = mae(y[group], y_hat[group]) - mae_all',
      '    log(f"{group}: gap={gap:.3f}")',
      '',
      'sim = DiscreteEventSim(clinics, capacity)',
      'plan = sim.optimise(forecast, equity=True)',
      '>>> uptake gap reduced by 18.4%'
    ].join('\n');
    if (still) { code.textContent = src; }
    else {
      var c = 0;
      (function type() {
        c++;
        code.textContent = src.slice(0, c);
        code.scrollTop = code.scrollHeight;
        if (c >= src.length) { setTimeout(function () { c = 0; type(); }, 2500); return; }
        setTimeout(type, src[c] === '\n' ? 140 : 22 + Math.random() * 30);
      })();
    }
  }

  /* Reveal sections as you scroll */
  var rev = document.querySelectorAll('.home-reveal, #listing-home-pubs tbody tr');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && !still) {
    var ro = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('is-in'); ro.unobserve(e.target); } });
    }, { threshold: .12 });
    rev.forEach(function (el, i) { el.classList.add('will-reveal'); el.style.transitionDelay = (el.tagName === 'TR' ? (i % 5) * 0.08 : 0) + 's'; ro.observe(el); });
  }
})();
</script>
